headline: Science Academies' SRFP 2027 applications close 30 November
quote: The last date for receipt of applications online is 30 November 2026.
claim: The three national Science Academies' Summer Research Fellowship Program 2027 closes online applications on 30 November 2026. Listed eligible students include BSc (Research) in the III year and BE/BTech/BCA in the II and III years, with 65% or above average marks in core subjects and one teacher's recommendation.
why_it_matters: A funded two-month stint with an Academies guide suits a third-year; check your degree name matches a listed row and line up one teacher's recommendation before 30 November.

opportunity.org: Indian Academy of Sciences (with INSA and NASI)
opportunity.audience: UG students: BSc (Research) III year only; BE/BTech/BCA II and III year; BS/BSc II year; 65% or above average marks in core subjects; one teacher's recommendation
opportunity.note: Page: 'The last date for receipt of applications online is 30 November 2026.' headline: ETH Zurich summer research fellowship takes applications 1 November to 16 December
claim: ETH Zurich's Department of Computer Science takes applications for its Student Summer Research Fellowship from 1 November to 16 December 2026 at 13:00 CET. The fellowship runs 2 July to 27 August 2027, pays a CHF 4,000 stipend and covers travel and visa expenses; applicants need two years of study completed by the start.
why_it_matters: Funded two-month placement in a Swiss CS lab for bachelor students with two years done; needs transcript, CV and a one-page statement before 16 December.

headline: Gnani AI internship challenge closes 10 November for Indian students
quote: Final submissions close at 11:59 PM IST on November 10, 2026.
claim: Gnani AI's Great Indian AI Internship Challenge closes final submissions at 11:59 PM IST on 10 November 2026. Enrolled students in India aged 18 or older, solo or in a team of two, build on Gnani's models for a chance at up to 100 paid six-month internships with stipends up to ₹1 lakh a month, plus ten ₹50,000 awards.
why_it_matters: A short build on Indian-language speech models can lead to a paid six-month internship; awards are decided separately from internship selection, so a good demo pays off either way.

opportunity.title: Great Indian AI Internship Challenge
opportunity.audience: Currently enrolled students at an Indian college or university, 18 or older, solo or with one teammate
opportunity.eligibility_quote: Open to enrolled students in India, aged 18 or older. Build solo or in a team of two.
opportunity.note: The brief is open: build any working application on Gnani AI models or APIs (Prisma v2.5 speech-to-text, Timbre text-to-speech, Evon v3.3). headline: Code for India's agentic AI hackathon closes submissions 15 November
quote: Judging covers every project deployed to any cloud by 15 November 2026.
claim: Code for India's Code for a Billion: Bharat Agentic-AI Hackathon judges every project deployed to any cloud by 15 November 2026, with winners announced on 5 December 2026. Entrants pick one of ten public-impact areas, the ₹18 lakh prize pool is paid per track or category, and the event is open to students, professionals and indie developers, solo or in teams, fully online.
why_it_matters: A free, fully online build with ₹18 lakh in prizes and an open-source portfolio piece; projects start in the AgentFoundry IDE and must be deployed by 15 November.
